description:
For every article and category an import brought in: the path its page had on the old help center ('from') and the path of the page that replaced it here ('to'), 200 a page, in exactly the shape helpcenter_bulk_create_redirects takes. Use it so the old help center's links keep working once its address points here.

Apply it page by page with helpcenter_bulk_create_redirects once the user is moving the old address here; redirects unlock only after the user has claimed the help center, verified their email and activated a plan (see helpcenter_get_help_center's capabilities). A draft is not a page yet: its redirect is refused (target_not_found) until it is published, so apply the map again then (an existing 'from' is re-pointed, never duplicated).

Read-only.

Args:
  - import_id (number, required)
  - page (number, optional): default 1.
  - response_format ('markdown' | 'json'): default 'markdown'.

Returns: { import_id, source_host, redirects: [ { from, to } ], meta: { page, per_page, total_pages, items_count } }.

agent_key.description: The api_key helpcenter_create_help_center returned for this help center, exactly as returned. Required on every call: this endpoint has no sign-in, so the key is how each call says which help center it acts on. It is sent to HelpCenter.io as this call's credential and nowhere else, and it is never shown again: keep it for the whole task, and never show it to the user or write it into content.

import_id.description: The import's id, from helpcenter_scan_import or helpcenter_list_imports.

page.description: Page of the map, 200 redirects each (default 1).

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for a human-readable summary or 'json' for the full structured payload.

name: helpcenter_get_import_redirect_map
title: Get an Import's Redirect Map
